title: Spectrum Now Accepting Entries
content: Spectrum 24 Call for Entries Poster (detail) byJustin GerardThe 24th annual competition ofSpectrum Contemporary Fantastic Artis now accepting entries. For more than two decades, Spectrum has been the pre-eminent showcase of imaginative realism, which includes science fiction, fantasy, concept art, paleoart, comics, and imaginative sculpture.The jury this year includesChristian Alzmann,Laurie Lee Brom,Mark Newman,Victo NgaiandJohn Picacio, all leaders in the field.It's a collection that art buyers notice. The organizers kept the entry fees low. If you get a piece selected, they send you a complimentary copy of the big book anywhere in the world.Also, the latest annual,Spectrum 23: The Best in Contemporary Fantastic Artis back from the printers and now available.Spectrum 24entry info
